turnout.notes: California turnout rows use the official SOS Statement of Vote voter participation statistics by county. Registered-voter totals are based on the 15-day Report of Registration and do not include voters registered after the 15-day close; Same Day Voter Registration may occur from 14 days before Election Day through Election Day.

reviewCharts.warning: California review rows are county-level President-versus-U.S. Senate full-term comparisons from official Statement of Vote county totals. They are useful for county-level context, but they are not precinct-level vote-share scatter plots.

historicalBaselines.warning: California historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Statement of Vote workbooks. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.
